'''Kaleela''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaleela was mentioned in the [[2010]] roleplaying game sourcebook ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="TCWCG" />
